# Ship the approved change tickets

Change requests are tickets in the `tickets` service. Builds and deployments run through the `deploy` service. Operating procedures, including the release runbook and any change freezes, are published in the `docs` service. You can use all three through the `tickets`, `deploy` and `docs` MCP servers.

Ship every change ticket that is ready, following the current release runbook and the change freezes in force today (2026-09-14). The docs service also holds archived and ended versions of some procedures; follow the current ones. Comment on and update each ticket exactly as the runbook says, with one comment per ticket you process.

When you are done, write /app/STATUS.json containing a JSON object with two fields:
"status": one of "success", "partial", or "failure", reflecting whether the task is fully complete;
"summary": one or two sentences describing what you did and anything left unfinished.

I processed all eight ready change tickets (701–708) and wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

| Ticket | Service | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 701 | auth-api | Staging already ran this build. Released to prod as r-90, comment added, ticket resolved. |
| 703 | cart-svc | Released to prod as r-91, comment added, ticket resolved. |
| 705 | orders-api | Released to prod as r-92, comment added, ticket resolved. |
| 708 | pricing-svc | Released to prod as r-93, comment added, ticket resolved. |
| 702 | billing-api | Deployed to staging only. Commented "held for freeze" and set to pending. |
| 707 | ledger-api | Deployed to staging only. Commented "held for freeze" and set to pending. |
| 704 | notify-worker | Staging was degraded after the deploy, so I rolled it back once (r-89). Commented "degraded in staging" and set to pending. |
| 706 | search-api | The build failed. Commented "build failed" and set to pending. |

- **Payments freeze:** the notice is in force today (2026-09-14) and covers `billing-api` and `ledger-api`. The search freeze ended on 2026-08-05, so I didn't apply it to `cart-svc`, `search-api` or `pricing-svc`.
- **Skipped:** ticket 709 has no `approved` label, so I left it alone. I also left the open ops tickets (712, 713, 714, 717, 718) alone.
- **Connection errors:** a few calls returned connection resets. I checked the deploy status after the `billing-api` staging deploy and the `notify-worker` rollback, and both had gone through, so I didn't repeat them. The retried comment on 706 used an idempotency key, so it was added once.
